mapper.select: SELECT compID AS id,compCode AS code,compName AS name,CAST(isDisabled AS UNSIGNED) AS disabled,'ehr_company' AS source_table,compCode AS original_code FROM ehr_company UNION ALL SELECT id,CASE compCode WHEN '01' THEN '001' WHEN '02' THEN '002' WHEN '03' THEN '003' WHEN '04' THEN '004' ELSE compCode END AS code,compName AS name,CASE CAST(state AS UNSIGNED) WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS disabled,'t_company' AS source_table,compCode AS original_code FROM t_company LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT depID AS id,depCode AS code,depName AS name,compID AS companyId,adminID AS parentId,depGrade AS grade,director,depProperty AS property,depNum AS number,xOrder AS sortOrder,remark,depCustom1 AS custom1,depCustom3 AS custom3,depCustom5 AS custom5,CAST(isDisabled AS UNSIGNED) AS disabled FROM ehr_department LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id,departmentNum AS code,departmentName AS name,status,createTime,updateTime,effectiveFrom,effectiveTo FROM fnd_department LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id,CASE code WHEN '04' THEN '004' ELSE code END AS code,name,status FROM fnd_company WHERE code IN ('04','004') LIMIT #{limit}
